# pve_storage_prune_backups (Action)

Prune backups on a storage according to retention options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_storage_prune_backups" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_storage_prune_backups.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.

### Optional

- `prune_backups` (String) Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.
- `type` (String) Either 'qemu' or 'lxc'. Only consider backups for guests of this type. One of: `qemu`, `lxc`.
- `vmid` (Number) Only prune backups for this VM.
